free_tier.stated: The dedicated list, in USD with a CAD figure beside it: a Xen Dedicated with 2 x Xeon E5-2650 v2, 256 GB DDR3 ECC, a 500 GB SSD and a 500 Mbps uplink at USD 49 a month or USD 539 a year; a Baboon with the same CPUs and 256 GB but 2 x 12 TB of disk and a 1 Gbps uplink at USD 69; a Baboon E5-2697 v2 at 24 cores / 48 threads with 256 GB, 2 x 120 GB SSD and 2 x 12 TB at USD 79; an Epyc Greyhound with an EPYC 7551P at 32 cores / 64 threads, 128 GB DDR4 ECC, 3.2 TB NVMe and 100 TB a month on 10 Gbps at USD 112; and an Elephant Storage with 24 x 8 TB, 256 GB RAM and 200 TB a month on 10 Gbps at USD 448.50.
